schemes.api_key.description: "To authenticate yourself to ShipEngine, you need to include an `API-Key` header in each API call. If you don't include a key when making an API request, or if you use an incorrect or expired key, then ShipEngine will respond with a `401 Unauthorized` error.\nLearn more about API keys in our [authentication guide](https://docs.shipstation.com/apis/shipengine/docs/guides/auth).\n"
